title: Follow Frame
description: A dashed frame that trails the cursor and names the action waiting there.
usage: For playful surfaces — onboarding, product tours, marketing panels. The label must name a real action. Several zones on one page follow the pointer independently.
a11y: Pointer-only by design; touch and keyboard users lose nothing, since the frame carries no information the panel itself does not. Each zone animates only while its frame is moving. Under prefers-reduced-motion the frame stays parked in the center; with --k-mscale set to 0 it jumps to the pointer without easing.
